**D. Salmonella typhi.** Hektoen enteric agar is a selective, differential medium for enteric Gram-negative pathogens (Salmonella and Shigella). The note that it grows protozoan trophozoites and cysts is wrong, because protozoa aren't cultured on it. C. difficile is the classic post-antibiotic cause of diarrhea, but it is a strict anaerobe that doesn't grow on this medium, so a positive HE culture points to Salmonella.

CONFIDENCE: 72
